gates.title: Exact-candidate compilation and published CI evidence
gates.owner: GitHub Actions plus an independent reviewer
requiredEvidence: terminal-success exact-head workflow bound to the final commit
terminal-success deterministic synthetic-merge workflow
clean tracked tree and compiled/tested native targets

gates.title: Independent semantic review
requiredEvidence: review submitted after the last required workflow becomes terminal
review binds base, head, source tree and prospective merge identity
reviewer principal and credential chain are independent of the author/generator

gates.title: Real model, provider, runtime and device identity
gates.owner: inference deployment owner and independent observer
requiredEvidence: exact model weights, tokenizer, preprocessing, quantization and license/SBOM
runtime binary, provider endpoint and device identity
authenticated terminal observations from an actual consumer

gates.title: Future-calendar efficacy and retention
requiredEvidence: preregistered future windows and support conditions
disjoint evaluation, retention and unlearning slices
independently observed outcomes with uncertainty and censoring

gates.title: Empirical biomimicry or embodiment claim
requiredEvidence: declared empirical hypothesis and comparator
target-specific measurements rather than software analogy
independent analysis and limitations

gates.title: Target-host and hardware qualification
requiredEvidence: named operating system/runtime/device or hardware target
p50/p95/p99 resources, deadlines, failure and recovery results
independent emergency-stop or rollback evidence where applicable

gates.title: External owner consent and enrollment
gates.owner: external service, homeserver, browser-profile or fleet owner
requiredEvidence: explicit target-specific consent and scope
expiring enrollment identity and credential references
revocation, migration and rollback disposition

gates.title: Operator acceptance
requiredEvidence: operator-run acceptance on the exact deployed candidate
fault, accessibility, observability and recovery results
no author/generator self-acceptance

gates.title: Canary, selection, signing, promotion and release
requiredEvidence: independently selected candidate and signed artifact
bounded canary with abort/reconcile/rollback evidence
normal policy merge/promotion/release without administrator bypass
